senses.gloss:
m. (-म्बः)
A sort of large shrub, (Cassia alata.)
f. (-म्बा)
A legume, a pod; also सिम्बा.
E.
शि to make small, deriv. irr.; also शिम्बि.

f. (-म्बा-म्बिः or -म्बी)
A legume, a pod: see शिम्बा, &c.

f. (-म्बिः-म्बी)
A legume, a pod.
E.
शि to make small or sharpen, deriv. irr.; also शिम्बा, and सिम्बा.

m. (-कः)
A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus max.)
f. (-का)
A legume, a pod.
E.
कन् added to the last; also शिम्बा, &c.

f. (-का)
Grain in pods, as pulse, &c.
E.
सिम्बा a pod, कन् aff., fem. form.

f. (-र्णी)
A sort of bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.)
E.
शिम्बि a pod, and पर्ण leaf, aff. ङीष्; also with कन् added fem. form शिम्बिपर्णिका.

(उ) षिम्भु r. 1st cl. (सिम्भति)
1 To hurt or kill.
2 To speak.
3 To shine.

m. (-मः)
All, entire.
E.
षि to bind, मन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-मा)
1 A boundary, a limit.
2 A field.
3 A bank, a shore.
4 Rectitude, observance of due bounds in morals, &c.
5 The nape of the neck.
6 The scrotum.
E.
see सीमन्.

m. (-मा)
A boundary, a limit, a landmark, or mound, &c. serving to fix the limits of estates, &c.
2 A field.
3 The nape of the neck.
4 The scrotum.
E.
षिञ् to bind, इमनिन् Uṇādi aff.; also with the aff. डाष्, or a final vowel, fem. form, सीमा.

m. (-न्तः)
A separation of the hair on each side, so as to leave a distinct line on the top of the head.
mn. (-न्तः-न्तं)
The head.
E.
सीमन् limit, of the hair, and अन्त end, form irr.

m. (-कः)
An infernal being.
n. (-कं)
Red lead, a mark with which is sometimes made along the division of the hair.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-नी)
A woman in general.
E.
सीमन्त the separation of the hair, and इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
One of the Saṃskāras, or a purificatory and sacrificial ceremony, observed by women in the fourth, sixth, or eighth month of their pregnancy.
E.
सीमन्त partition of the hair, and उन्नयन arranging; this forming an essential part of the rite.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being parted or divided.
E.
सीमन्त used as a passive verb, शानच् aff.

n. (-ङ्गं)
A land or boundary mark.
E.
सीमा, and लिङ्ग mark.

m. (-दः)
Litigation or dispute respecting boundaries.
E.
सीमा, and विवाद dispute.

m. (-क्षः)
A tree serving as a boundary mark.
E.
सीमा, and वृक्ष a tree.

m. (-न्धिः)
The meeting of two boundaries.
E.
सीमा, and सन्धि junction.

m. (-कः)
A kind of tree.
E.
ष्यम to sound, and कीकन् Uṇādi aff., य changed to इ, and that made long.
